block_node.block_desc:
Trigger the downstream function-call subsystem from an interrupt service routine. The block output triggers the downstream connected function-call subsystems when the selected interrupt occurs.
Use the 'Task priority' parameter to set the priority of the downstream function-call subsystem.
Use the 'Processor core' parameter to set the core on which to run the task.

Triggers execution of a task in your application. The task is represented in the Task Manager block.
Connect the block output to the event port of the respective task in the Task Manager block.

Create a task trigger for each set of task triggers arriving at the block input ports from the Task Trigger blocks.
Select the number of task triggers to merge together.
Connect the input ports to the Task Trigger block ouputs and the output to a Task Manager task event port.

Represents the effects of a task in your application. This block can be used to model the impact of a task on your application without explicitly implementing such a task.
The block should be matched to a task in the Task Manager. The code generated for the Proxy Task is included in the code that is generated from your model.
Set the period to match the period of the corresponding task in the Task Manager.
